_comment: Live source for the deployment docs. The read key is PUBLIC and read-only by construction: it decrypts this vault's content and nothing else, and cannot write. Rotate by replacing this file — the site picks it up on the next load, no rebuild.
maintained_by: the SG/Send team — see MAINTENANCE.md inside the vault
_ref_ttl_note: How often the mutable HEAD pointer is re-checked, in seconds. Inside this window the reader reuses the last answer, so navigating the docs costs zero network requests; it is also the worst-case delay before a new commit shows up. The vault panel's 'check for new commit' button ignores it. Set to 0 to check on every page view.
